arbitration.reason: todo mundo ri da situação is a valid present; riam is barred by singular agreement.

substring test lets 'recebeu' satisfy an (eu) tag and lets an earlier blank answer supply the subject; whole-word match on literal segments only, same-person exception kept. The suggested rejection tests live in files outside the supplied source; Codex should add them as a follow-up without changing this guard.
L1 bans imperfetto in every turn; 'che ha dimenticato ieri' stays inside L1 licensed forms and scaffolds ha→ho. Coupled: de/en gloss and both scene captions.
'auf meine Reihe warten' is not German; use 'wartete, bis ich an der Reihe war' in turn and pattern, chunk 'bis ich an der Reihe war', term 'dass ich an der Reihe bin' (keeps the possessive sense).

Settled interpretation: the one-valid-choice rule governs grammar blanks (all cloze, and recalls whose answer is a verb form). A noun-trophy recall is a story-memory checkpoint; its fallbacks must be same-class nouns compatible in gender/number that are not story-consistent alternatives, which all ten Portuguese sets already satisfy. Replacing three of ten would be inconsistent, and the agreement-trick sets turn recall into a gender check. Step is also inactive in the current B1 runtime.
'organizou a espera' is unnatural; 'soube que era a sua vez' is colloquial pt-BR and is answered exactly by the senha/painel follow-up; era is licensed from L4.
'o grupo terminou o jardim' is ordinary Brazilian metonymy for finishing garden work and the German gloss mirrors it; recycles L1 naturally.
'Reparaturlabor/Labor' reads as a laboratory; Werkstatt is the everyday term and matches the English 'workshop'. Seven German fields.
No additional active cloze ambiguity, gender leak, register slip or staging breach found; remaining items are cosmetic or inactive-step notes listed above.
